title: AI investment cycle may have peaked, Jefferies warns; raises India allocation to 14%
description: According to a recent Jefferies report, global investment in artificial intelligence appears to be facing a mid-cycle correction. Although US tech giants have ramped up their capital spending, there are growing concerns regarding both financing and profitability. This situation may adversely impact US economic growth. Investors are advised to explore opportunities outside the AI realm, especially in healthcare and biotechnology sectors.
